sentences.text: This application is filed seeking reduction of the sentence to the period already undergone, on humanitarian grounds.

2. Appellant was convicted by judgment dated 30th August 2018 for offence under Section 376/342/506 IPC in FIR No.130/2014 PS Mangol Puri and by order on sentence dated 31st August 2018, was awarded RI for 7 years.
3. The Court has perused the impugned judgment and finds no reason to reduce the sentence on humanitarian ground, as pleaded by the counsel for the appellant.
4. In any event, as per Nominal Roll on record dated 3rd November 2022, the unexpired portion of sentence was one year and 6 months.
Since about a year and a half has passed since then, in any case period of sentence This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 22/07/2024 at 21:04:37 would have been over,
5.
Accordingly, there is no merit in this application.

6. Application accordingly stands dismissed and disposed of accordingly.
1. Appeal shall remain on Board and list in due course as per its own turn.
2. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
